meta.author:
詞：陳世智、林美雅、文敏華、沈慧婉
曲：陳世智

lines.a: 在祢的寶座前 天使聚集讚美
lines.b: Before Your throne, angels gather and praise

lines.a: 榮耀 永遠屬於祢
lines.b: Glory belongs to You forever and ever

lines.a: 萬國萬口萬邦 穿著潔白衣裳
lines.b: From every nation, tribe, tongue, and land, dressed in white robes

lines.a: 我們前來 向主歌唱
lines.b: We come to sing to our Lord

lines.a: 我們獻上全心的讚美
lines.b: We give our wholehearted praise

lines.a: 歸於至高全能大君王
lines.b: To the highest and almighty King of kings

lines.a: 我們的聲音 述說祢的榮耀
lines.b: Our voices declare Your glory

lines.a: 祢的慈愛 直到永遠
lines.b: Your unfailing love endures forever

lines.a: 我們獻上生命的敬拜
lines.b: We offer our lives in worship

lines.a: 渴慕能夠更多親近祢
lines.b: Longing to draw closer to You

lines.a: 蒙恩的兒女 歌頌祢的美好
lines.b: As Your blessed children, we sing of Your goodness

lines.a: 歡迎祢的國度 降臨這土地
lines.b: We welcome Your kingdom to come to this land

lines.a: 在祢的同在裡 我們揚聲敬拜
lines.b: In Your presence, we lift our voices in worship

lines.a: 愛慕 頌讚不停息
lines.b: Our love and praises never cease

lines.a: 昔在今在永在 萬世尊崇愛戴
lines.b: You were, You are, and You are to come, adored by all generations

lines.a: 為要訴說 祢的愛
lines.b: All to declare Your great love

lines.a: 哈利路亞 哈利路亞
lines.b: Hallelujah, Hallelujah

lines.a: 哈利路亞 榮耀都歸於祢
lines.b: Hallelujah, all glory belongs to You
